description: This file defines a React hook 'useOrganizationFeatureOptIn' for managing feature opt-in settings at the organization level, including fetching data, updating state, and handling UI notifications.

methods.name: useMutationCallbacks
methods.description: Creates callback functions for success and error handling during mutation, showing toast notifications.

methods.name: normalizeFeatures
methods.description: Transforms raw feature data into normalized feature objects.

methods.name: getOrgBlockedWarning
methods.description: Returns null, placeholder for organization blocked warning.

methods.name: isOrgBlockedByHigherLevel
methods.description: Returns false, placeholder for higher-level organization block check.
